text:
Lina: Heads up — I'm drafting release notes for the docs site deploy next Tue. Need a quick check on: SDK snippet changes (JS client rename), a failing embedding example in guides/migration/embedding.md, and the changelog bullets. Anyone available to pair for 15m?

Sam: I can do 11:15. I pushed a fix to the snippet in PR #1791 but didn't update the relnotes yet. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1791

Aaron: Re: known issues, we should include a short blurb about older SDKs getting 400s on embedding calls. Can someone confirm the error wording so PM copy is accurate?

docs-bot: Link Scanner: found 1 broken anchor in guides/migration/embedding.md -> '#embedding-legacy' (404)

Zoe: That anchor moved during the site restructure to migration/11-embedding.md#legacy-embeddings. We should update the internal link and add a redirect in _redirects.yaml.

Mike: I'll take care of the redirect deploy, but we need the redirect PR before Friday so it can be included in the release.

Lina: Here's the failing snippet we saw in prod tests (old SDK style):

```
// old JS client
const resp = await client.embed_stream("Here is my text");
// returns 400: "invalid input shape"
```

Suggested replacement for the docs (new SDK):

```
// new embeddings API
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: "rwd-embed-1",
  input: "Here is my text"
});
```

Sam: That looks right. I'll update PR #1791 to include the new snippet and add a short note in the changelog examples section showing both JS + Python minimal examples.

Aaron: Draft for known-issue blurb: "Note: Calls to older SDK clients (<0.9.x) may return 400 on embedding requests due to a changed request shape. Workaround: pin to an older server-compatible SDK or follow the Embeddings migration guide (link)." Does that work?

Zoe: Fine by me. Also add a one-liner in the migration guide about the anchor change so redirects are discoverable.

Mike: Checklist for final handoff: 
- Sam: update PR #1791 snippet + changelog bullet (assigned)
- Zoe: open redirect PR for anchor -> _redirects.yaml (assigned)
- Aaron: finalize known-issue copy and paste into relnotes draft (assigned)
- Mike: schedule redirect deploy once PR is merged
- Lina: finalize release notes draft and post in #docs for signoff by 5pm

Lina: Thanks. I'll post the draft later today and ping reviewers. If anyone finds additional broken anchors run: `make linkcheck` locally or `./scripts/link-scanner` in CI. :thumbsup:

Sam: Quick question — do we want to include a short code diff snippet or just the final example in the changelog? I vote final example + a one-line diff in migration guide.

Aaron: Agreed. Keep relnotes concise. Migration guide can have the diff and the why.

Lina: Perfect — pairing at 11:15 then. I'll open the relnotes draft PR and add the TODOs.

docs-bot: Deploy Bot: reminder — docs build queue at 09:00 UTC. Redirect PRs merged after that will go out in the next deploy.
